title: Surface Contract
description: An independently renderable and verifiable UI boundary

designProfileId.description: App-wide visual profile applied to this surface

surfaceId.description: Stable identifier, used in briefs, fixtures, Previews, tests, and artifacts

responsibility.description: What this surface is responsible for rendering

inputs.description: Data and configuration this surface requires

outputs.description: Observable outputs: visible content, accessibility tree, interaction targets

systemContainer.description: Primary system container (NavigationStack, TabView, List, Form, Sheet, etc.)

masonryEnabled.description: Whether masonry is conditionally enabled (Discovery only)

states.description: Array of stateId values this surface supports
